## $\bigstar$ Quadrature of the Parabola

### The Setup

::: {#def-parabolic-segment}
## Parabolic Segment
The region bounded by the parabola $y = x^2$ and the chord from $(a, a^2)$ to $(b, b^2)$.
:::

### Geometric Facts

::: {#lem-inscribed-triangle-area}
## (Exercise)
The inscribed triangle has area $T = h^3$, where $h = (b-a)/2$.
:::

::: {#lem-circumscribed-parallelogram}
## (Exercise)
The circumscribed parallelogram has area $2h^3 = 2T$.
:::

::: {#lem-child-triangles}
## (Exercise)
The two child triangles have combined area $T/4$.
:::

### Putting it Together

::: {#thm-quadrature-parabola}
## Quadrature of the Parabola
The area of a parabolic segment is $\frac{4}{3}$ times the area of its inscribed triangle.
:::
